# School Performance Snapshot for Parent-Teacher Review

This dataset shows a clear pattern: **Grade 9C performs best overall**, while **Grade 9B is the weakest across all four measures**. Attendance and homework completion closely track quiz and final exam results, so the chart should make that relationship easy to see at a glance.

## Best Chart Choices and Main Trends

**Best charts for this dataset**
- **Grouped bar chart**: best for comparing all 5 classes across 4 measures side by side.
- **Heatmap**: best for spotting strengths and weaknesses quickly.
- **Radar chart**: useful for a simple “profile” of each class, but harder to read on paper than bars.

**Recommended one-page print chart**
- **Grouped bar chart** with classes on the x-axis and four colored bars per class:
  - Attendance %
  - Homework completion %
  - Quiz average %
  - Final exam %

**Why this is the best print choice**
- It is easiest for parents to understand quickly.
- It shows both overall performance and gaps between measures.
- It works well in black-and-white if labels or patterns are added.

## Class-by-Class Performance Table

| Class | Attendance % | Homework completion % | Quiz average % | Final exam % |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Grade 9A | 92 | 88 | 84 | 81 |
| Grade 9B | 85 | 79 | 76 | 74 |
| Grade 9C | 96 | 91 | 89 | 87 |
| Grade 9D | 88 | 83 | 80 | 78 |
| Grade 9E | 90 | 86 | 82 | 79 |

**Key trends**
- **Grade 9C leads in every category**: strongest attendance, homework, quiz, and final exam scores.
- **Grade 9B is lowest in every category**: it likely needs the most support.
- **Higher attendance generally matches better academic results**.
- **Homework completion appears linked to quiz and exam performance**.
- **Final exam scores are lower than quiz averages for every class**, suggesting a drop between regular checks and end-of-term assessment.

## Parent-Friendly Interpretation

- Classes with **better attendance and homework habits tend to score higher**.
- The gap between quiz and final exam scores suggests students may need more revision before major tests.
- **Grade 9C** can be used as a model for strong study habits.
- **Grade 9B** may benefit from attendance follow-up, homework support, and test practice.
